name: Reading Time
description: Estimate the reading time of a post. Calculated on every post save, cached in post meta, and exposed via the `orb/reading-time` block + the `Reading_Time::get_reading_time()` static accessor for themes.

settings.label: Words per minute
settings.description: Reading speed baseline used in the calculation. 200–300 covers most adult readers; 270 is a common middle.

settings.label: Suffix
settings.description: Appended after the number in the rendered output. Use whichever phrasing matches the rest of your UI (e.g. "min read", "minute read").

settings.label: Add time for images
settings.description: Counts image tags in the rendered content and adds a small reading allowance for each (heaviest for the first 10, lighter for the rest). Turn off for posts where images are decorative and don't slow scanning.
